candidate.tree_hash_contract: SHA-256 over every non-target regular file below the named repository path, sorted by repository-relative path, with each UTF-8 path and byte payload prefixed by its unsigned eight-byte big-endian length

image_tree.hash_contract: same repository-relative length-prefixed tree contract as candidate source trees

fixtures.input_binding: Every table row includes expected moving and fixed byte hashes; the loader rejects a mismatch before candidate execution.

construction.fixed_images: Independent analytic phantoms stored as float32 NIfTI on a 2 mm grid.
construction.interpolant_exact_rows: Moving voxels are generated by a standard-library trilinear sampler over the stored fixed voxels at the declared moving-to-fixed truth, followed by intensity = 80 + 1.17 * fixedSample.
construction.independence: The generator imports no reframe4s code and does not execute Flashalign.
construction.nonlinear_contrast_boundary: The nonlinear-contrast cohort uses a signed-square-root intensity mapping and is an approximation distribution excluded from exact-recovery admission.

preexecution_oracle.implementation: The fixture generator independently recomputes trilinear samples on common full support and compares normalized correlation at truth with fixed perturbations.
preexecution_oracle.perturbations: plus/minus 0.1 mm translations and 0.3 degree target-frame rotations; affine rows also include plus/minus 0.5 percent axis scales

runner.candidate_mode: automatic public run only; supplied initialization and development modes are unavailable
runner.output_stage: On every successful transform, construct FlashalignOutput from the original moving image, materialize one linear resampling on the fixed grid, consume its values and validity weights, count non-finite values, and charge the complete interval to output timing.

accuracy_gates.denominator_policy: Every sealed row must appear exactly once. Any non-success receives a 100 mm adjudicated error.
accuracy_gates.nonlinear_contrast: descriptive approximation distribution only; no exact-recovery admission gate

required: last checkpoint whenever one or more linearizations executed
candidate revision and input hashes equal the sealed values

cost_evidence_requirement.candidate_identity: The cost receipt must use the source and provider hashes sealed here.
cost_evidence_requirement.scope: Charge input preparation, structural capture, every candidate refinement attempt, final audit, and final output sampling when an output image is produced.
cost_evidence_requirement.timing_rule: Report all stage times and total wall time for each sealed row; do not treat transform-only execution as complete image-output cost.
cost_evidence_requirement.status: sealed into the automatic runner; pending execution after exceptional-failure evidence is qualified

execution_attempts.error: invalid candidate result: candidate metrics are non-finite

execution_policy.permitted_post_seal_changes: Only evidence-integrity fixes that do not alter candidate numerical behavior, fixtures, transforms, thresholds, or adjudication; any such change requires a new manifest and disclosed reseal.
execution_policy.reseal_reason: FA-L27 changed failure capture and accounting without changing successful numerical behavior, fixtures, transforms, thresholds, or adjudication. The candidate source-tree hash and failure-result encoding were rebound before any candidate execution. The benchmark-only runner was then corrected, still before execution, to sample the original moving image once through FlashalignOutput and account for final output cost. Attempt 1 exposed a non-finite diagnostic sum and wrote no row; the harness now counts non-finite output voxels and sums finite values only. The candidate, fixtures, transforms, thresholds, failure penalty, configuration, and adjudication remain unchanged.
execution_policy.next_step: Retry this rebound runner, preserve every row, and adjudicate without candidate-aware tuning.

claim_boundary: This seal establishes an unopened, interpolation-identifiable analytic-synthetic confirmation court. It contains no Flashalign result and makes no accuracy, cost, MRI, anatomical, clinical, publication, or cross-method claim.
